Sofia —

Welcome and thanks for partnering with Redwood. We're starting vendor onboarding for ClearData Analytics so we can issue a PO and enable payments. To finish tax/finance checks we need the following items (we can accept PDFs):

- Completed W-9 (if US entity) OR completed W-8BEN-E (if foreign) with authorized signature
- Confirmation of legal entity name exactly as registered, and the EIN/TIN shown on the form
- Remittance address and preferred payment method (ACH routing + account number or SWIFT for wire)
- Signatory name and title on the form (printed and signed)

Note: our vendor platform will run an IRS TIN match. If the TIN/name don't match our automated check we will request an IRS CP 147C confirmation letter or a bank statement that matches the vendor name. Without cleared TIN verification we cannot issue the PO or process invoices — this may delay payments.

Also please confirm your standard payment terms (e.g., Net 30) so our procurement team can put that in the PO. Once we have the tax docs and verification we'll aim to create the PO within 3 business days.

If you prefer, you can upload documents to the DocuSign link here (we accept signed PDFs): https://docusign.com/embeddedSigning/ABC123-cleardata

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
